references.text: Moses gave similar instructions to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh to help their brothers before they could settle in their own land.
Moses reminds the tribes of their obligation to help their brothers until they too have found rest in the land the Lord gives them.
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of the promise they gave Moses to help their brothers in the fight for the land.
Moses warned against leaving their brothers, which these tribes avoided by keeping their promise over many years.
The command to love the Lord and keep his commands, laws, and statutes aligns with the call to keep the Lord's commands.
Joshua reiterates the importance of keeping the Lord's commands and loving him, which is at the heart of the faithfulness shown by the tribes.
